title: in the hand mirror, her caked face: the foundation gone patchy and orange along the jaw against her paler neck; she lowers the mirror slowly
line: oxidized, and left me looking more tired than my bare face.
motionPlan: From this frame: in the hand mirror, her caked face: the foundation gone patchy and orange along the jaw against her paler neck; she lowers the mirror slowly — one slow lowering, about 2 s; handheld over her shoulder, still.
